name: Borrow Against Position and Reputation
summary: Open a credit line against a vault position, at rates set by ERC-8004 reputation tier.
when_to_use: The agent needs spending liquidity but wants to keep its yield-earning position intact. Higher reputation = better rates and collateral ratios.

mcp.hint: Ask: 'show Arcis credit tiers' or 'check loan health for loan N'

cli.command: arcis credit tiers   # see rates by reputation tier

risk: Collateralized borrowing. Health factor must stay above liquidation threshold. Rates and collateral ratios improve with ERC-8004 reputation tier.
